FX-FBLEND-001.says: Stretch 100, in 2, offset 1: t is n - 2 + 1, whole.

FX-FBLEND-002.says: Stretch 200: half a frame of source a frame.

FX-FBLEND-003.says: Stretch 50: two frames of source a frame.

FX-FBLEND-004.says: Stretch 150: two thirds of a frame a frame.

FX-FBLEND-006.says: Stretch 33.3, not a round share: f is 3, 6 and 9.

FX-FBLEND-007.says: Stretch 10000, the most: a hundredth of a frame a frame.

FX-FBLEND-008.says: Stretch 1, the least: a hundred frames a frame.

FX-FBLEND-010.says: Stretch 100 with both switches on: every time is a whole frame, so the drawings on twos, red, blue, green, exactly as with both switches off.

FX-FBLEND-011.says: Stretch 200, the layer's switch off: each drawing is held four frames, red, blue, green, green.

FX-FBLEND-012.says: Stretch 200, both switches on: frames 3 and 7 fall half way between two drawings and are half of each; frames 1 and 5 fall between two frames of the same drawing and are that drawing, bit for bit; frames 9 and 11 would mix with frame 6, past the last drawing, so they are green alone.

FX-FBLEND-013.says: Stretch 200, the layer's switch on and the composition's off: as FX-FBLEND-011.

FX-FBLEND-014.says: A file written before D-216, with none of the four fields: the drawings on twos, and saved again it still has none.

FX-FBLEND-015.says: Stretch 150, both switches on: the times go in thirds, so frames 1, 2, 4, 5, 7 and 8 are two thirds of one and a third of the next.

FX-FBLEND-016.says: Stretch 75, both switches on: sped up, frames 1 and 2 fall a third and two thirds of the way on; frame 3 is local frame 4 exactly, and local frame 3, stepped over, is never mixed in.

FX-FBLEND-017.says: A gap: nothing exposed on local frames 2 and 3. Stretch 200, both on: frame 3 is red half mixed with nothing, so red at half covering; frames 4 to 7 are empty; frame 7 mixes nothing with green.

FX-FBLEND-018.says: Drawing 2 has no file. Stretch 200, both on: frames 3 and 7 mix with an empty picture and say MEDIA_SEQUENCE_GAP, as frames 4 to 6 do; frames that do not read drawing 2 say nothing. No other drawing stands in for it.

FX-FBLEND-019.says: Source offset 1, stretch 200, both on: every time is half a frame on, so frames 0 to 3 are red, half, blue, blue... one frame earlier than 012.

FX-FBLEND-020.says: In point 3, stretch 200, both on: nothing before frame 3, and from there FX-FBLEND-012's frames, three frames later. The stretch runs from the in point.

FX-FBLEND-021.says: A composition layer showing a composition, 6 frames long, of the three drawings on twos, stretched 200 with both switches on: FX-FBLEND-012's frames. The composition's end is its source's end.

FX-FBLEND-022.says: A composition layer showing a white dot 2 pixels wide moving right a pixel a frame, stretched 200 with both on: on odd frames the inner composition is drawn twice, a frame apart, and the two are half and half, so the dot is 3 pixels with half-covered ends.

FX-FBLEND-023.says: Keys are not stretched: the layer's position is keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, and it is at x = n on frame n while its drawings play at half speed with Frame Mix.

FX-FBLEND-024.says: A file that writes the defaults: stretch 100 and the composition's switch false. They read as absent, the drawings on twos, and saved again neither field is written.

FX-FBLEND-030.says: Drawing Dissolve 1 on twos, stretch 100: the second frame of each hold is half the drawing and half the next; the last drawing has no next and holds.

FX-FBLEND-031.says: Drawing Dissolve 2 on threes: a third, then two thirds, of the next.

FX-FBLEND-032.says: Drawing Dissolve 5 on twos: a hold of two frames dissolves over one at most, so the same frames as FX-FBLEND-030.

FX-FBLEND-033.says: Drawing Dissolve 3 on ones: every drawing is shown once, whole.

FX-FBLEND-034.says: Drawing Dissolve 1 with a frame of nothing between red and blue: a hold before a gap does not dissolve.

FX-FBLEND-035.says: Drawing Dissolve 1 where the same drawing is exposed twice running: frame 1 is red, bit for bit.

FX-FBLEND-036.says: Drawing Dissolve 1 into drawing 2, which has no file: frame 1 is red at half and says MEDIA_SEQUENCE_GAP, as frames 2 and 3 do.

FX-FBLEND-037.says: Drawing Dissolve 1 with the composition's frame blending switch off: the dissolve is the layer's own and still happens, as FX-FBLEND-030.

FX-FBLEND-038.says: Drawing Dissolve 1, stretch 200 and both switches on: the dissolved frames are mixed again, so frame 1 is three quarters red and a quarter blue.

FX-FBLEND-039.says: Drawing Dissolve 1 and stretch 200, the layer's switch off: each dissolved frame is held two frames.

FX-FBLEND-040.says: In 0, out 6, 100 to 200: the out point goes to 12.

FX-FBLEND-041.says: In 10, out 17, 100 to 150: 7 frames become 10.5, rounded half away to 11.

FX-FBLEND-043.says: In 4, out 10, 100 to 1: 6 frames become 0.06, and a layer keeps one frame.

FX-FBLEND-044.says: In 0, out 5, 300 to 100: 5 frames become 1.666..., rounded to 2.

FX-FBLEND-052.says: A stretch below 0, playing backwards, which is not part of this.

FX-FBLEND-053.says: A stretch written as a word.

FX-FBLEND-054.says: A layer's frame blending that is Pixel Motion, which is not part of this.

FX-FBLEND-055.says: A layer's frame blending written true rather than the word frame_mix.

FX-FBLEND-056.says: A composition's switch that is not true or false.

FX-FBLEND-057.says: A drawing dissolve that is not a whole number of frames.

FX-FBLEND-060.says: A stretch on a solid layer, which has no drawings to time.

FX-FBLEND-061.says: Frame blending on a null layer.

FX-FBLEND-062.says: Frame blending on an adjustment layer.

FX-FBLEND-063.says: A drawing dissolve on a composition layer, which has no exposure of its own.
